title: Central Nashville Escape with Secluded Forest Deck
description:
Experience all West Nashville has to offer in this quiet modern retreat! Just minutes from Trader Joe’s, Crumble, and Hattie B’s famous hot chicken. Close to the Richland Creek Greenway (for running, biking, and walking). We’re about a 12 minute drive/Lyft/Uber from Broadway/Downtown Nashville. A relaxing escape in the trees with easy city access.

The space
Welcome to our super clean two-bedroom, 925 sq ft apartment in the lovely Hillwood estates neighborhood. 

This fabulous space is located on the ground floor of our main house. You will have your own private entrance with a keypad lock on the door. There is a pass-through door from the apartment to the main house that is locked from both sides. Guests have complete private access to the backyard super deck for the duration of their stay.

Each of the apartment’s two bedrooms has a memory foam queen-sized bed with 600+ thread-count linens. The living area has an Italian leather fold-out couch with an ultra-comfortable full-sized memory foam mattress. There is a full kitchen with an under-counter fridge and freezer, a dishwasher, a full stove/oven, a microwave, and a coffee-maker & burr grinder. There is a 48' TV with Netflix, HBO Max, Disney Plus, and Amazon Prime. There is high speed internet, a full sized washer/dryer, and a bluetooth speaker system. There's also a turntable with a great selection of records.

The apartment is well stocked with everything you might need, including fluffy towels, coffee, shampoo & conditioner, a blow dryer, and various other staples.

Guest access
Your private entrance and cozy outdoor patio are around the back of our main house. There are two dedicated parking spots (one covered). Guests also have full access to the backyard super-deck and a small BBQ grill.

Other things to note
Please help yourself to the fresh coffee beans, snacks, and anything else you find in the apartment. We provide lots of basic items you may need (shampoo/ conditioner, spices, dish and laundry soap, ibuprofen, etc).  Let us know if you’re looking for something special. We’ll do our best to help. 

Our calico cat (named Kitten) lives on the property and in the upstairs house. We want you to know she is never allowed in the apartment, in case some of our guests have allergies.

We are a family of 5 (2 parents & 3 kids in college). We moved here from Austin, Texas back in 2000. We LOVE Nashville and all it has to offer. Several years ago we took the kids out of school and road schooled around the country, camping in national parks and staying in hotels, Airbnbs, etc. We had such an great experience and met the most wonderful people, that once we got home we decided to create our own space to share with fellow travelers.
